verdict.rationale: The only evidence of published performance numbers is indirect. A community commenter refers to a vendor page whose benchmark runs on 5M records and cites a 5s count(*) latency, which implies some benchmark is published. None of the first-party docs in the pack show the benchmark itself, its methodology, or any latency or recall figures. Missing for 10: first-party benchmark documentation, vector recall metrics, p50/p99 latency figures, methodology at realistic scale, and independent reproduction.
